subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: What cross-session run-event observation contract should OpenClaw expose for long-running `sessions_send` runs, and which payloads may be visible to the caller?
rationale: The remaining work defines a new cross-session event API with authorization, redaction, buffering, replay, and channel-delivery semantics that code inspection cannot safely choose for maintainers.

options.title: Design a bounded event observation contract
options.body: Add a permission-checked core `agent.events` or equivalent run-progress API with redaction, retention, replay, and session visibility rules before adding the agent-facing tool.

options.title: Fold into structured process events
options.body: Make this issue depend on the broader process/step event contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52826, accepting that `sessions_send` progress remains unavailable until that design lands.

options.title: Keep final-only semantics
options.body: Reject live progress for peer `sessions_send` and document `timeoutSeconds: 0`, `sessions_history`, and final announce as the intended workflow.

recommendation.title: Design a bounded event observation contract
recommendation.body: Add a permission-checked core `agent.events` or equivalent run-progress API with redaction, retention, replay, and session visibility rules before adding the agent-facing tool.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent and historical connection to `sessions_send`, run-wait helpers, and adjacent agent/gateway runtime surfaces.
